title: Avionics Technicians
description: Install, inspect, test, adjust, or repair avionics equipment, such as radar, radio, navigation, and missile control systems in aircraft or space vehicles.

tasks.text: Adjust, repair, or replace malfunctioning components or assemblies, using hand tools or soldering irons.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on equipment adjustment for performance

dwas.name: Install machine or equipment replacement parts.
Adjust equipment to ensure optimal performance.
Repair worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.

tasks.text: Lay out installation of aircraft assemblies and systems, following documentation such as blueprints, manuals, and wiring diagrams.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Laying out work physically per specifications

dwas.name: Lay out work according to specifications.

tasks.text: Keep records of maintenance and repair work.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Log maintenance and repair records from data

tasks.text: Test and troubleshoot instruments, components, and assemblies, using circuit testers, oscilloscopes, or voltmeters.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Troubleshooting aided; hands-on diagnosis human

dwas.name: Test electrical equipment or systems to ensure proper functioning.
Troubleshoot equipment or systems operation problems.

tasks.text: Connect components to assemblies such as radio systems, instruments, magnetos, inverters, and in-flight refueling systems, using hand tools and soldering irons.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Electrical installation is hands-on licensed trade work

dwas.name: Install electrical components, equipment, or systems.

tasks.text: Install electrical and electronic components, assemblies, and systems in aircraft, using hand tools, power tools, or soldering irons.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Electrical installation is hands-on licensed trade work

dwas.name: Install electrical components, equipment, or systems.

tasks.text: Coordinate work with that of engineers, technicians, and other aircraft maintenance personnel.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Real-time coworker coordination is relational work

dwas.name: Confer with coworkers to coordinate work activities.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Set up and operate ground support and test equipment to perform functional flight tests of electrical and electronic systems.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Electrical testing requires hands-on instrument use

dwas.name: Test electrical equipment or systems to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Assemble components such as switches, electrical controls, and junction boxes, using hand tools or soldering irons.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Electrical subsystem assembly requires manual dexterity

dwas.name: Assemble electrical components, subsystems, or systems.

tasks.text: Interpret flight test data to diagnose malfunctions and systemic performance problems.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Performance data analysis; equipment context human

dwas.name: Analyze test or performance data to assess equipment operation.

tasks.text: Fabricate parts and test aids as required.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Part fabrication requires physical machining and handling

tasks.text: Operate computer-aided drafting and design applications to design avionics system modifications.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI proposes configurations; engineer verifies physical constraints

dwas.name: Develop equipment or component configurations.
dwas.gwa_name: Drafting, Laying Out, and Specifying Technical Devices, Parts, and Equipment

tasks.text: Assemble prototypes or models of circuits, instruments, and systems for use in testing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Electrical subsystem assembly requires manual dexterity

dwas.name: Assemble electrical components, subsystems, or systems.

emerging_tasks.task: Perform installation, testing, adjustment, and repair of avionics equipment in uncrewed aerial vehicles, such as drones.
